notablePrerequisites:
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter.
Urban Daggertooth has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have the highest life total.
description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Urban Daggertooth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Urban Daggertooth and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
Activate Pentad Prism's ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
